Blue Angel products and services

The Blue Angel is the reliable label for environmentally friendly products and services in many business sectors. Numerous everyday products from various different areas of life carry the label: e.g. furniture, laundry detergents or paints. More than 70,000 products and services from more than 1,800 companies have now been awarded the Blue Angel.
